signatures.description: Implement a Selinger-style join optimizer: given relations with cardinalities, per-column distinct counts and a set of equi-join predicates, enumerate join orders with subset dynamic programming, keeping the cheapest plan per (subset, interesting sort order) and pruning dominated plans by physical-property equivalence. Support left-deep and bushy trees with hash join (needs equi-key ordering), nested-loop and sort-merge join, and enforce a DP size limit that falls back to a greedy heuristic once the subset lattice exceeds it. Return the winning plan's cost, tree shape and per-operator output orderings, and show no alternative plan over the same join set with the same interesting order can beat it.
